feature: tower D uses shared construction grid placement
workshop_verified_scope: Owned normally constructed N tower: D grid, repeated D, occupied destination rejection, green-cell movement and ghost cleanup. Other cases retain their explicitly listed simulation-only or pending status.
changes: Every D press and move-button click starts a fresh shared placement session.
Preview and commit use the same snapped grid position and existing tower footprint.
Server rechecks ownership, alive/defeated state, ability, cooldown, finite coordinates, range and occupancy.
Out-of-range snapped cells are rejected instead of silently clamping to another cell.
Ordinary and UR towers retain existing movement implementations and all gameplay state.

Ghost model follows the current tower model, scale and yaw; skin uses an available GetSkin getter, otherwise the current applied asset model_skin, otherwise 0. Real Dota NPCs may expose SetSkin without GetSkin.
Switching towers retires the old ghost; proxy configuration failure removes the tracked proxy before the next update.
Grid reconciliation preserves named future-tree reservations without passing strings to EntIndexToHScript, and retains live resource-tree occupancy.
